attempts.summary: Reviewed TZ300 official public excerpts (Panasonic Korea news, NA spec sheet, operating instructions PDF) for scope/unit/condition warnings only. No repository changes requested or made. Key warnings identified: (1) 35mm-equivalent focal varies by aspect ratio and by 4K PHOTO/video and O.I.S./Level Shot conditions, so equivalentFocal must carry a mode condition; (2) 4K 24p sensor output listed as 25fps in one spec and 24fps in another, a scope conflict to flag; (3) weight 337g is with battery and SD card, 295g without, so condition basis must not be conflated; (4) 5-axis HYBRID O.I.S.+ is lens-based, not sensor-shift IBIS, and is unavailable for 4K video, Digital Zoom, and 4K Live Cropping; (5) sensor size stated only as 1-type, no physical mm given; (6) region/model variants (ZS300P/PP vs TZ300E/GA/GH/GN/GT/GD) change frame rates.
